import os,json

out=[[5,7,5,5,5,7,5],[7,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,5,7,5],[5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[4]*7,[5,7,5,5,5,7,5],[7,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,5,7,5],[5,5,7,5,5,5,5],[4]*7,[5,7,5,5,5,7,5],[7,5,7,5,5,5,5],[5,5,5,5,5,7,5],[5,5,7,5,5,5,5]]

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # separator: full row/col of the same nonzero color
    # find first separator
    def is_sep_row(r): v=g[r][0]; return v!=0 and all(c==v for c in g[r])
    def is_sep_col(c): v=g[0][c]; return v!=0 and all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(h))
    seps=[('r',i) for i in range(h) if is_sep_row(i)]+[('c',j) for j in range(w) if is_sep_col(j)]
    kind,idx=seps[0]
    if kind=='r':
        block=[row[:] for row in g[:idx]]
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        # replicate block into each segment
        starts=[0]+[s+1 for k,s in seps if k=='r']
        ends=[s for k,s in seps if k=='r']+[h]
        for st,en in zip(starts,ends):
            if st==0: continue
            for i in range(en-st):
                out[st+i]=block[i][:]
        return out
    else:
        block=[[g[r][c] for c in range(idx)] for r in range(h)]
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        starts=[0]+[s+1 for k,s in seps if k=='c']
        ends=[s for k,s in seps if k=='c']+[w]
        for st,en in zip(starts,ends):
            if st==0: continue
            for c in range(st,en):
                for r in range(h):
                    out[r][c]=block[r][c-st]
        return out
